newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Futures Exchange links up with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Futures Exchange links up with NYMEX.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange Ltd will launch its trading partnership with the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) on Friday, June 13, senior exchange executives said.

"The initial phase of this linkage will provide HKFE members with direct access to NYMEX's futures and options markets on the NYMEX ACCESS after-hours electronic trading system," exchange chairman Frank Wong said at the exchange's annual general meeting on Thursday.

The products available for trading in Hong Kong include gold futures, silver futures, copper futures, platinum futures, light, sweet crude oil futures and options, heating oil futures and options, unleaded gasoline futures and options, natural gas futures and options, liquefied propane futures and electricity futures, Wong said.
Eight Hong Kong Futures Exchange member firms have installed NYMEX ACCESS terminals in their offices, Wong said.

They are AIM Futures Ltd, Fimat Futures (Hong Kong) Ltd, Ong First Chicago Asia Financial (Futures) Ltd, The New China Hong Kong Futures Ltd, South China Commodities Ltd, Tai Fook Futures Ltd, Tanrich Futures Ltd and Wocom Ltd, he said.
